en: The front of the postcard features a tranquil park setting beneath a large, lush, overgrown tree canopy, creating a shady alcove with benches. Two people can be seen sitting on benches, with one reading a book, suggesting a peaceful retreat. The text on the lower part of the image reads: 'Bad Pyrmont. Ein ruhiges Plätzchen für Leseratten.' The reverse side includes indications for a stamp, address lines, publisher information, and a stamp from 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont.'
